mapper.select: select t.id , t.node_key , t.snapshot_dt , t.queue_name , t.queue_label , t.message_count , t.consumer_count , t.created_by , t.created_dt from monitor_mq_snapshot t inner join ( select queue_name, max(snapshot_dt) as max_dt from monitor_mq_snapshot group by queue_name ) x on t.queue_name = x.queue_name and t.snapshot_dt = x.max_dt order by t.queue_name
